verdict.rationale: Salesforce documents an official MCP server, APIs, and a CLI `sf data query` command. Sales Cloud also stores accounts and opportunities and syncs emails, so an agent has first-party routes to the CRM data a brief needs. The evidence never shows these interfaces actually assembling a pre-meeting account brief of open deals, recent emails and history. missing for 10: documentation of which CRM objects or tools the MCP server exposes, evidence that email activity and history are retrievable via the API/MCP, a documented account-brief workflow or example, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent compile an account brief — open deals, recent emails, and history — from CRM data via the API or MCP server before a meeting
